audit.whatIsWrong: Ornn's Q is called 'Volcanic Rumble' in content early. The ability is Volcanic Rupture. The whole knockup mechanic is also described only as 'wall-knockup' / 'Dodge his Q', which hides where the wall actually comes from.
audit.why: Riot: Volcanic Rupture 'slams the ground, sending out a fissure dealing damage and slowing enemies hit. After a small delay, A MAGMA PILLAR FORMS at the end location.' Searing Charge: 'If Ornn collides with TERRAIN while charging, the impact creates a shockwave... and knocks up enemies.' So the pillar Ornn just made IS the terrain he charges into — he does not need a lane wall. The tell is the pillar, and the rule is to never stand between Ornn and it.
audit.corrected: Name fixed to Volcanic Rupture. tldr, winCon, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0] and dontsFull[0] now describe the pillar-into-charge sequence and give both cooldowns (Q 9s, E 14s at rank 1).

audit.whatIsWrong: The full-layer chart reads Darius/Skill/Ornn/Ornn/Darius/Ornn/Ornn and the content chart reads Darius/Skill/Ornn/Ornn/Darius/Ornn/Ornn — but the content whys underneath read Darius for stages 1-4, Ornn at Level 6, Darius at First item, Ornn at Two+ items, which is exactly the packet levelChart. Five of seven rows contradict their own explanation, and Level 6 is inverted on both charts.
audit.why: Whys[1] 'Level 2 still yours; Ornn just farms while you stack bleed'; whys[2] 'At 3 your E-pull denies his Searing Charge escape'; whys[3] 'Levels 4-5 you keep out-DPSing'; whys[5] 'First item you spike back'. Meanwhile whys[4] hands Level 6 to Ornn — the one stage both charts currently give to Darius. 51.24% over 2,746 games fits a lane Darius owns until the ultimate lands and again at first item.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Darius, Darius, Darius, Darius, Ornn, Darius, Ornn on both layers as one atomic group, with the Level 2, 3, 4-5, 6 and First-item whys rewritten so text and row agree.

audit.whatIsWrong: Call of the Forge God's cooldown is never given anywhere, and phases[4].why — the Level 6 row — is generic Guillotine boilerplate carrying raw LaTeX ('R = d + a \times Stacks').
audit.why: Call of the Forge God is 140/120/100s and thrown from 2500 range: the elemental damages, slows and applies Brittle to anything it runs over, and Ornn can recast to charge into it and knock up. At 140s in a lane he otherwise loses, that number IS the advice — it is the longest cooldown either player has, and every Darius all-in should be scheduled against it.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why, content mid, spikes[1] and whys[4] now carry the 140s figure and describe the run-over Brittle plus the recast knockup; the LaTeX fragment is gone.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns has a PDF page footer baked into it — it ends '• • Darius Top Lane Matchup Database 43'. breakdown.wave has the same corruption plus two whole other sections ('Key Mechanical Cooldowns', 'Darius Ghost:') pasted inside it between 'Best wave' and 'Worst wave'.
audit.why: This content was clearly imported from a PDF and never cleaned. MatchupCoach.dc.html slices breakdown.wave on the literal markers 'Best wave' / 'Worst wave' / 'Crash timing', so all of the interleaved text renders inside the Best-wave box, footer and all.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns is rewritten from scratch with real numbers, which removes the footer. breakdown.wave is NOT edited — deleting the interleaved block is a ~450-character cut that no ±10% edit can express; flagged for the user.

notes: STRUCTURAL, not fixable inside the length band: breakdown.wave for this matchup is PDF-import wreckage — it contains 'Key Mechanical Cooldowns', a full 'Darius Ghost' paragraph and a '• •' bullet artefact pasted between 'Best wave' and 'Worst wave'. Because MatchupCoach.dc.html slices that field on those literal markers, all of it renders inside the Best-wave box. Removing it is a ~450-character deletion and needs a direct fix in champ-data/darius.full.js. I did remove the same import's page footer ('• • Darius Top Lane Matchup Database 43') from breakdown.cooldowns, which was rewritten wholesale anyway. Packet suspectName check: 'Use Bellows Breath' in wants.foe[0] is a FALSE POSITIVE — Bellows Breath is the exact Riot name for Ornn's W. 'Volcanic Rumble' in early was a genuine error and is corrected to Volcanic Rupture. NOT verified, so left standing where it already appears and removed only where I was rewriting anyway: eight fields describe a 'Bellows Breath shield'. Riot's Data Dragon text for Bellows Breath says only 'Ornn advances, breathing fire. Enemies hit by the final gout of flame become Brittle' and the kit carries no shield flag — so I could neither confirm nor deny a shield and wrote nothing either way. See unverified. Two more derived-flag notes: Volcanic Rupture carries a 'grounding' flag that Riot's text does not support (slow and pillar only), so no grounding claim was written; and Bellows Breath's range field reads 25000, which is plainly a data artefact for a short cone and was not used.
